d.a: Distribution and habitat. The typical variety G. acuminatum var. acuminatum is widely distributed from India, Nepal, through Indo-China Peninsula, to China and Japan. In China, it occurs widely from the southwestern area to Taiwan. It grows in evergreen broad-leaved forests, open forests, valleys, or near streams, usually from low altitude to 2600 m. The species is recorded from Ilan and Taipei Hsien, through Nantou and Taichung Hsien, to Kaosiung and Pingtung Hsien, in Taiwan.
